profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, and trades under the ticker UBER. Its website presents the Uber platform and apps as tools for earning, eating, commuting, getting a ride, and simplifying business travel. The site points to a City Hub for transport options and points of interest, and to Uber for Business, which the company describes as giving organizations more control, deeper insights, and features built for enterprise users, with business travel and meal programs managed on one dashboard.

The site text also carries a promotional offer for new delivery persons who have never previously signed up to deliver with Uber Eats. Under the stated terms, eligible participants may earn $150 for every 15 unique deliveries completed within 14 days of signing up, up to a maximum reward of $450, with the account verified within 180 days of signup and the offer expiring on 11/1/2026. The company states the offer is promotional and not a guarantee of future earnings.

The site text does not describe any AI products. No products or MCP servers are listed for the company, and no lawsuits are recorded. Its legal exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 matters. Its SEC filing record carries CIK 0001543151.
